title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Payment Rail in the Retention Share
content:
An AutoPay authorization in active status on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement adds to the retention share by its payment rail:

- a **bank-account** authorization adds **10 percentage points**;
- a **card** authorization adds **5 points**;
- no active authorization adds nothing.

The authorization is the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization drafting this rental agreement, in active status; its payment rail — bank account (ACH) or card network — follows from the AutoPay method on that record.

| Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on the agreement | Addition to the retention share |
|---|---|
| active, drafting a bank account | 10 points |
| active, drafting a card | 5 points |
| suspended, cancelled, or none | none |

## Hypothetical case
A tenant whose agreement is drafted by an active Bluegate AutoPay Authorization on a personal checking account: 10 points are added to the retention share.
